== Summary ==
Decipher's errata for Weequay Marksman: the entry in Decipher's ''Star Wars CCG Glossary Supplement'' (29 January 2002), PDF page 8, cropped at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited. Image for [[Weequay Marksman (Decipher Errata 2002)]].

Source: Decipher, [http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossarysupplement.pdf ''Star Wars CCG Glossary Supplement''] (updated 29 January 2002), PDF page 8, entry Weequay Marksman. Wiki copy: [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf|Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041106202626/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossarysupplement.pdf Internet Archive].
